criteria.criterion: Approved pilot scenarios complete end-to-end without uncontrolled workflow breakage
Material recommendations retain traceable evidence references
Human approval is preserved at designated authority gates
Critical pilot errors are detected and recorded
criteria.target: 100% observed critical errors captured in incident register

criteria.criterion: Required pilot evidence artifacts are complete
Performance is measured against an agreed scenario baseline
criteria.target: Baseline and measured results recorded for every mandatory scenario

criteria.criterion: No protected credential or prohibited confidential asset is exposed in public pilot evidence
Institutional reviewers can reproduce designated pilot outcomes from retained evidence

decision_rule: PASS requires all mandatory criteria to be evidenced as satisfied. Targets may be contractually refined before a live institutional pilot, but changes must be version-controlled and approved before execution.
